title: Register the Azure Arc and Update Manager resource providers
summary: Register every resource provider Arc-enabled servers and Azure Update Manager need, once per target subscription, before the first onboarding wave.
code:
az account set --subscription "<subscription-id>"

for ns in Microsoft.HybridCompute Microsoft.GuestConfiguration Microsoft.HybridConnectivity Microsoft.Compute Microsoft.Maintenance; do
  az provider register --namespace "$ns"
done
# Add Microsoft.AzureArcData only if SQL Server instances will be Arc-enabled.

# Check the state (Registered) before you start a wave
az provider list --query "[?namespace=='Microsoft.HybridCompute' || namespace=='Microsoft.Maintenance'].{ns:namespace, state:registrationState}" -o table
notes: A missing Microsoft.HybridCompute registration fails azcmagent connect on every machine in the wave.
Microsoft.Compute is needed even in Arc-only subscriptions; without it Arc machines produce no periodic assessment data.
